prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **World Martial Arts Academy** at **1057 Cave Springs Blvd.** It offers structured classes for preschoolers (ages 4–5) and kids (6–10), with a focus on confidence, focus, discipline, and self-defense. A directory lists it at **4.6 stars from 57 Google reviews**; reviews are generally positive about the instructors and welcoming atmosphere, though one reviewer raised concerns about how consistently young students master material before promotion. The school lists tuition at **$159/month** and says there’s no long-term contract or cancellation fee—confirm current pricing and trial options directly.

If you’d rather have your child try **Brazilian jiu-jitsu**, **Gracie Barra St. Peters** offers age-grouped children’s classes, including ages 4–6 and 7–9, with bully-prevention and self-defense content. For a more traditional karate option, **Terry Creamer’s All Star Karate** is at **235 Jungermann Rd., Suite 101**, and serves kids through teens.

I’d visit a trial class at two schools and compare how the instructors manage the kids, how much time students spend actively practicing, and whether the class feels like a good fit for your child. ([World Martial Arts Academy](https://blackbeltstl.com/), [Gracie Barra St. Peters](https://graciebarrastpeters.com/), [All Star Karate listing](https://saintlouis.kidsoutandabout.com/content/terry-creamers-all-star-karate))
